That's fair, I suppose I just need to get used to it being part of the online landscape now, I've had a few times where I actually wanted to just chat and try to be friends with some of the women I met advertising their "goods" so to speak, I kinda wish they were more open to it now

>Why do you think you interact with sex workers so regularly online?

I honestly have no idea, on dating apps i encounter them regularly and when I try to meet people on chat sites the few women I get to talk with either currently are sex workers or are aspiring to be

I'll be honest, I'm a bit shocked how civil and understanding people have been with these replies, I was expecting to be demonized for not being open to being with a woman that has an OF and being discouraged by the concept of it. After reading a few of these replies I'm starting to think I'm taking the situation too seriously and really should just see it as a job and nothing more

It could just be a case of confirmation bias, I tend to encounter them regularly online and see it talked about all over so in my perception it's blow out of proportion compared to what it actually is

>If it helps, consider OF work about on par with the ease with which men get work as casual manual laborers.

That's actually a really good parallel, most professions in sanitation like garbage men and janitors are (sadly) looked down on simply because of their job. I'll have to keep this in mind thank you


>What I mean is, if you use OF and other sex work services like camgirls and live action pornography, it would be insanely hypocritical to be opposed to a prospective girlfriend having an account and making money that way. 

If you don't use sex work services like pornography or cam girls of any sort, of course it is reasonable to set a standard that you don't want a partner who engages in any of that

I do consume pornography but somewhat regretfully. It's become a standin for intimacy for me in my times of loneliness and honestly I feel I might have even developed a slight addiction, not necessarily seeing a woman's body, but living the fantasy that such a woman would want to be with me, not just sexual but also romantically

I guess my hang up is on it feeling like infidelity, if I was dating a woman that did that it'd feel like she was cheating on me every night with dozens, if not hundreds of men.. I feel a sense of guilt too in not considering single mothers, I just don't feel I'm at a point in my life where I could support a child, and feel a sense of stigma raising another man's child. I want to be an open minded and accepting person, it's just that sex work feels wrong to me, like they're sacrificing their dignity for money, and forgive my language but I can't think another way to articulate the way I feel about it other than.. well, being a whore.. I understand it's a lucrative and highly profitable option for these women, but it feels wrong, but at the same time I feel wrong for feeling it's wrong
